factors.label: Known Unresolved Issue
factors.description: Known, recurring, or unresolved hardware/software anomaly present in the system.
factors.diagnostic_question: Is there a known, recurring, or unresolved hardware/software anomaly present in the system?

factors.label: Safety Margin Degraded
factors.description: System operating outside tested thermal, structural, or environmental safety margins.
factors.diagnostic_question: Is the system operating outside tested thermal, structural, or environmental safety margins?

factors.label: Schedule Pressure
factors.description: External launch window, commercial, or public schedule pressure influencing the review.
factors.diagnostic_question: Is there external launch window, commercial, or public schedule pressure influencing the review?

factors.label: External Conditions Marginal
factors.description: Environmental conditions near or outside design limits.
factors.diagnostic_question: Are environmental conditions (ambient temp, sea state, space weather) near or outside design limits?

factors.label: Dissent Raised and Overridden
factors.description: Engineering dissent was raised and subsequently overruled.
factors.diagnostic_question: Did an engineering team, subsystem lead, or contractor raise formal or informal dissent that was overruled?

factors.label: Missing Evidence Acknowledged
factors.description: Board acknowledged missing telemetry or inconclusive data but proceeded.
factors.diagnostic_question: Did the board acknowledge missing telemetry, inconclusive test data, or unproven assumptions but proceed anyway?

factors.label: Prior Normalization of Risk
factors.description: Similar anomaly occurred on prior flights and was accepted as acceptable risk.
factors.diagnostic_question: Has this identical or similar anomaly occurred on prior flights and been accepted as acceptable risk?

factors.label: Independent Review Skipped
factors.description: Independent technical review or mandatory safety escalation was bypassed.
factors.diagnostic_question: Was an independent technical review, peer verification, or mandatory safety escalation bypassed or accelerated?
